_comment: Vermont members whose Open States party is wrong, per member (the districts are multi-member). Source: legislature.vermont.gov people/loadAll/2026 (current labels), cross-checked against Ballotpedia's member list, 2026-10-19. P/D (Progressive first) = Vermont Progressive Party, counted as other ('O'); I = Independent. Joseph Parsons is Independent on the legislature site and Republican on Ballotpedia; the legislature's own label is used.
